title: Mercyrail: Haven Bound demo is out today!
author: njbmartin
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm excited to finally be releasing the demo of my game today: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5209880/Mercyrail\_Haven\_Bound\_Demo/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5209880/Mercyrail_Haven_Bound_Demo/)

Playable on both Windows and Linux!

I'm truly excited about the possibilities that AI now unlocks as it has always been my dream to create games! I went to university hoping to get into game development and ended up building websites and apps for the last 15 years...

After watching Snowpiercer last year, I had this idea to create a survival game heavily inspired by Snowpiercer, Mini Metro and Fallout. I created the initial prototype myself and had every intention of spending my weekends building this game myself, but life got in the way.

Fast forward to the beginning of this summer, and I had just used Claude Sonnet 5 to create an entire website without me touching a single line of code. In the back of my mind, I kept thinking about this game. This game that I would quickly give up on if it wasn't for AI.

So I challenged myself. What if AI could take my prototype and turn it into a fully functional narrative driven game? My lunch times were now spent on writing detailed game design documents explaining what I was looking for. I'd then spend an hour or so in the evenings, after putting my daughter to bed, planning with Claude based on those documents, and Claude would work through the night.

It also uses OpenStreetMap data to create the entire UK rail network as realistically as possible. This is where I really struggled with AI because I was trying to get it to faithfully draw a realistic line between stations while consolidating the multiple lines on the real network into a single line between stations. It's still not perfect, but will continue working on it.

It's been an exciting journey, and I'm pleased to say that my initial vision has been brought to life thanks to AI. As I said, without it, I would have given up on this idea entirely.
